statement.en: ESGE suggests that patients adhere to a clear liquid diet for a minimum of 48 hours and abstain from all oral intake (nil by mouth) for at least 8 hours prior to the procedure. This fasting period may be increased according to the amount of esophageal food retention upon upper gastrointestinal endoscopy or the detection of a sigmoid-type esophagus in the previous work-up.
